bullets: [1] Initialize all Weights with random values
[2] Provide one training sample at a time (and its corresponding target label)
[3] Go Forward : Start from Input Layer, Calculate Net_j, O_j for each layer till reach output layer

[4] Go Backward : Start from Output Layer, Calculate Δw_ji, W_ji for each weights of Output layer
Δw_ji = η O_i O_j(1-O_j) (t_j - O_j)   Store: δ_j = O_j(1-O_j) (t_j - O_j)   (for each node at output Layer)

[5] Go Backward : go to previous Layer, Calculate Δw_ji, W_ji for each weights of Hidden layer
Δw_ji = η O_i O_j(1-O_j) [Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)]   Store: δ_j = O_j(1-O_j) [Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)]   (for each node at hidden Layer)

[6] Repeat [5] till reach first hidden layer
Remember: δ_k = δ_j of next layer   ( which is already calculated in previous step )
